assist.analog-hint: Off means a trigger grips at full strength the moment it is pressed.
assist.checkpoints-hint: Turns on the optional checkpoints levels carry.
assist.grab-hint: A slightly bigger reach around each hand.
assist.nofall-hint: Hazards and falling out of the level still get you.
assist.onehanded-hint: Both arms from one stick; the grab button swaps which arm you are moving.
assist.slowmo-hint: Practice at three-quarter speed. Solo only.
assist.smoothing-hint: Softens a shaky hand or a worn stick.
assist.sticky-hint: Your grip never tears — you only let go on purpose.
bindings.listening-hint: Press the button you want. Escape cancels.
bindings.sub: Every action is remappable, and every device keeps its own map.
bindings.title: Controls
bindings.touch-fixed: Touch controls are the buttons drawn on screen, so there is nothing to point somewhere else. Change the layout in Settings instead.
credits.attribution: A physics party game in the tradition of Heave Ho by Le Cartel Studio. Unaffiliated.
credits.body: Drawn, coded and playtested in-house. Every head, hat and level in this game is ours.
credits.title: Credits
hud.canvas-label_one: {{level}} — a hand-drawn physics level, players: {{count}}. The drawing itself is not screen-reader playable; the menus, world map and scrapbook are.
hud.canvas-label_other: {{level}} — a hand-drawn physics level, players: {{count}}. The drawing itself is not screen-reader playable; the menus, world map and scrapbook are.
input.blurb: All three are the real game — none of them is the fallback. Change any button in Settings.
input.couch: Up to four on one screen: any spare controller can press a button mid-level to drop in.
input.heading: How you play
input.keyboard-detail: WASD and arrows aim; Q and E grab. Grab assist is on by default.
input.mouse-detail: The mouse aims your right arm; left click grabs with it.
input.pad-press: Press any button on it — browsers hide pads until you do
input.touch-detail: One thumb per arm. Finger down reaches and holds, finger up lets go. Landscape works best.
invite.pending: Your invite is saved. It will open once the game is playable.
join.body: Press {{button}} and you will be drawn in at the last checkpoint.
join.title: Player {{n}}, join in?
level.crashed-body: The level could not be drawn on this device. Your progress is safe. Try another level, or try again.
level.failed-body: The level file would not load. Nothing you did — pick another one and we will look into this.
level.needs-two-note: This one needs two pairs of hands. Start it anyway and anyone who joins drops straight in.
level.objectives-blurb: None of these gate anything. The level ends when you reach the goal.
lobby.host-starts: Waiting for the host to start.
lobby.open-blurb: You get a six-character code and a link. Up to four of you.
lobby.title: Play with friends
lobby.waiting: Send the link. Anyone who arrives is drawn straight in, even mid-level.
map.failed-body: Something went wrong fetching the campaign. Your progress is safe — try again, or go back and play something else.
map.failed-title: The level list did not load
map.heading: The campaign
map.more-coming: More worlds are being drawn. What is here is finished and playable.
map.sub: Levels marked with a head can be finished alone. The rest want company.
mode.campaign-blurb: Eight worlds of levels, alone or with anyone who turns up. Your progress follows you.
mode.heading: How are we doing this?
mode.lobby-blurb: Open a private room and send the link, or type a code you were given.
mode.offline: Needs a connection — this one is offline right now.
mode.quick-blurb: Straight into a level with whoever is around. No code, no waiting room.
mode.showdown-blurb: For when co-operation has run its course. Best of five arenas, two to four players.
mode.sub: Everything here plays with a controller, a keyboard, or two thumbs.
objective.haul_one: Carry every relic to the goal
objective.haul_other: Carry every relic to the goal
objective.snapshot: Take the photo the level is asking for
orientation.body: Both thumbs need a screen half each. It plays in portrait, it just plays better this way.
orientation.title: Turn your phone sideways
pause.personal: This menu is yours — the level is still running.
pause.room-wide: Everyone in the room is paused.
pause.title: Paused
results.assisted: Assists were on, so this run goes on the assisted board. Same clear, different column.
results.title: Cleared
settings.assists-hint: All of these are yours alone and none of them are hidden — your seat shows what is on.
settings.audio-hint: Every sound has a visual twin, so the game is fully playable muted.
settings.deadzone-hint: Raise it if a resting stick drifts; worn sticks are common.
settings.pad-brand-hint: Detection is a hint, not a lock. Override it if your pad reports something odd.
settings.saturation-hint: Lower it if your stick cannot quite reach full deflection on the diagonals.
settings.tags-hint: Pins every player’s name over their head, on top of their colour and mark.
settings.title: Settings
settings.touch-auto-hint: Finger down reaches and holds; finger up lets go. The hand grips on contact.
settings.touch-two-stick-hint: Fixed sticks in the corners, with separate grab buttons. The full verb set.
tagline: You are a head with two enormous arms and no legs whatsoever. Grab, swing, and let go at exactly the wrong moment.
title: Bum's Rush
touch.hint-left: Drag here for your left arm
touch.hint-right: Drag here for your right arm
wardrobe.head: Heads
wardrobe.sub: Everything here is earned. Nothing is for sale and nothing expires.
wardrobe.title: Scrapbook
wip: Under construction — the physics, the worlds and the multiplayer are being built. Check back shortly.
